records.text: Romulus is Grand Inquisitor and commands the Inquisition.
Sorin served in the company led by Inquisitor Eustice.
The death of Arkin's mortal body released leyline flow, increasing Romulus's power.
Ishirala Floor 3 has triangular rooms and mirror portals. Its statue depicts Goodman.
Romulus ordered Ishi'go'dan to destroy a distant castle.
Aris survived the earlier destruction of her city by Ishi'go'dan.
Mira belonged to Captain Vale's Warden patrol.
The inn corridor has a mural of Captain Vale beside a window.
Breaking the temple seal freed magical energy that strengthened the Regent.
The temple floor is tiled blue and has three exits.
The Regent intends to close the harbor tomorrow; no closure has occurred.
